rows.implementation: Clear equipped brawler weapon and spawn pickups after player spawn.
Spawn four deterministic pickup pads around the active map using runtime primitives.
Convert incoming ROUNDS damage magnitude to brawler percent and suppress lethal health damage.
Apply velocity impulse scaled by current percent, weapon and card modifiers.
Eliminate players that cross camera-relative blast-zone bounds.
Increase air-control feel and expose card multipliers while leaving native ROUNDS bindings intact.
Register platform-fighter stat cards with UnboundLib CustomCard so native ROUNDS draft flow remains.
Use ROUNDS native 1v1 lobby/session; mod state is deterministic and each peer must run the mod.
